hero.title: Radiant Waves Media Morning Global News
hero.description: Wednesday, July 29, 2026. Good morning. Here are today's verified breaking headlines, world news, business, technology and sports updates from around the globe.

breaking: 🔴 Powerful 7.1-magnitude earthquake strikes southern Japan, causing casualties and structural damage
🔴 France and Spain continue battling major wildfires as a fresh heatwave spreads across southern Europe
🔴 United Nations warns that the 'climate alarm is blaring' as extreme weather intensifies worldwide
🔴 Zinedine Zidane officially begins his tenure as France national team head coach
🔴 Commonwealth Games action continues in Glasgow with athletics, boxing, swimming and para sports
🔴 Global markets focus on corporate earnings, inflation and energy prices
🔴 World leaders continue diplomatic efforts on regional security and humanitarian issues
🔴 Artificial intelligence investment continues expanding across major economies

featured.title: Strong Earthquake Rocks Southern Japan
featured.content: A powerful magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck southern Japan, causing fatalities, injuries and damage to buildings. Emergency services remain deployed while authorities continue assessing the full extent of the damage and warn residents to remain alert for possible aftershocks.

articles.title: Powerful Earthquake Hits Japan
articles.description: Emergency responders are carrying out rescue operations after a magnitude 7.1 earthquake struck southern Japan. Authorities are monitoring aftershocks while damage assessments continue.

articles.title: Wildfires Continue Across France And Spain
articles.description: Thousands of residents remain displaced as firefighters battle major wildfires across southern France and Spain. Extreme heat and strong winds continue to challenge containment efforts.

articles.title: UN Calls For Stronger Climate Action
articles.description: The United Nations says the 'climate alarm is blaring' as governments face increasing pressure to respond to extreme weather and climate-related disasters.

articles.title: Zinedine Zidane Begins France Role
articles.description: French football legend Zinedine Zidane officially starts work as head coach of the France national team, succeeding Didier Deschamps.

articles.title: Commonwealth Games Continue
articles.description: Competition continues in Glasgow with medal events in athletics, boxing, swimming, weightlifting and para sports as athletes compete for podium finishes.

articles.title: Markets Watch Inflation And Earnings
articles.description: Global investors continue monitoring inflation, company earnings, economic growth and energy prices as financial markets remain volatile.

articles.title: AI Investment Continues Worldwide
articles.description: Technology companies and governments continue increasing investment in artificial intelligence, cloud computing, robotics and cybersecurity.

articles.title: African Trade And Infrastructure
articles.description: African governments continue strengthening regional trade, transport infrastructure and investment partnerships under continental development initiatives.

articles.title: Asia Advances Digital Innovation
articles.description: Countries across Asia continue expanding investment in semiconductor manufacturing, digital infrastructure and advanced technology.

articles.title: Economic Outlook Remains In Focus
articles.description: Investors continue watching employment data, inflation trends and monetary policy decisions across the world's largest economies.

articles.title: Global Diplomacy Continues
articles.description: World leaders continue diplomatic engagement aimed at strengthening international security, humanitarian assistance and economic cooperation.

articles.title: Quote Of The Day
articles.description: Every sunrise is another opportunity to build a better future. Stay informed, stay focused, and keep moving forward.
